evidence: Mesh Console is documented as a required Glaze UI consumer but is not yet implemented.

The source foundation defaults to loopback-only HTTP, fail-closed relationship policy, bounded JSON input, restrictive state-file permissions, and explicit authority boundaries; the approved Wardveil contract adapter and runtime evidence remain pending.

The architecture limits Mesh to coordination metadata and prohibits unnecessary application payload centralization; the approved Privacy Shield contract adapter, retention controls, and runtime evidence remain pending.
The initial store uses atomic durable JSON persistence; Everkeep backup classification, export, restore, corruption handling, and recovery-evidence acceptance remain pending.

Wardveil Security contract implementation and runtime evidence
Privacy Shield contract implementation and retention/privacy evidence
Everkeep backup/export/restore contract and recovery evidence
Current Stable Glaze UI Mesh Console implementation and accessibility acceptance
Monitoring health adapter and health-evidence provenance
Target-environment runtime, rollback, backup, restore, and failure-mode acceptance
